description: This file defines the EmailConfigurationListener class, which hooks into Doctrine ORM lifecycle events for the EmailConfiguration entity to handle encryption and decryption of the SMTP password during persistence, updates, and loading.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationListener
classes.description: Listener class reacting to entity lifecycle events for EmailConfiguration to manage encryption and decryption of SMTP passwords.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Encrypts SMTP password before persisting if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Encrypts SMTP password before updating if encryption is enabled and the field has changed.

methods.name: postUpdate
methods.description: Decrypts SMTP password after update if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Decrypts SMTP password after loading from database if encryption is enabled.
